detail.abstract: In the tort of passing off, decision-makers regularly point out the continuity of doctrinal development and the ‘well settled’ nature of the law. Lord Parker’s speech in AG Spalding & Bros v AW Gamage Ltd (1915) plays a prominent role in this story of unfurling progress. In that case, he famously rejected the idea that passing off protects property in unregistered trading signs per se, in favour of a theory that identifies goodwill as the property right underlying the cause of action. This decision is now widely regarded as the moment at which passing off was definitively placed on its modern theoretical foundations. It is argued here that this narrative of the tort’s development conceals a significant, but largely unacknowledged, change that has taken place since Spalding v Gamage. At the time of Lord Parker’s speech, to the extent that it was considered at all, goodwill was envisaged as a relatively undifferentiated right in a claimant’s business. By contrast, today, the right protected by the law of passing off is generally treated as though it subsists directly in individual trading signs. Ironically, therefore, it is difficult to distinguish from the right in unregistered marks so emphatically rejected by Lord Parker himself. This analysis, which is based on a close reading of judgments handed down since 1915, presents a historical account of conceptual and linguistic developments in the tort over the last century or so. In so doing, it questions orthodox narratives about its form and foundations and raises significant questions about the future of the cause of action

AI.tldr: 本文质疑了假冒侵权法中关于法律发展连续性的传统叙事，指出自1915年Spalding v Gamage案以来，虽然表面上法律理论保持稳定，但实际上发生了重大但未被承认的概念转变——从保护整体商誉转向保护个别商业标识本身。
AI.research_question: 自1915年Spalding v Gamage案以来，假冒侵权法在概念和语言表述上发生了哪些未被承认的重大变化？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为假冒侵权法的发展具有连续性且理论基础稳固，但作者发现这种叙事掩盖了一个重要的概念转变，需要重新审视法律发展的真实轨迹。
AI.theoretical_framework: 假冒侵权法理论、商誉保护理论、知识产权法历史发展理论
AI.method: 对1915年以来判决书的细致文本分析，追踪概念和语言表述的历史演变
AI.findings: Lord Parker在1915年明确拒绝保护未注册商标本身的权利，强调保护的是商誉；但如今法律实践实际上已转变为保护个别商业标识本身，这与Lord Parker当初拒绝的观点难以区分
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了假冒侵权法发展的传统连续性叙事，揭示了未被承认的概念转变，为重新理解该侵权法的理论基础提供了新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 对法律实践者和法官具有启示意义，促使重新思考假冒侵权法的适用标准和未来发展方向，可能影响相关案件的判决思路

title: The Intuitions Age Creative Intuitionism & Reclaiming Knowledge in a Post-AI World: Toward a New Epistemology

detail.title: The Intuitions Age Creative Intuitionism & Reclaiming Knowledge in a Post-AI World: Toward a New Epistemology
detail.abstract:
Preprint version. DOI via Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.16985595

This is a pre-publication version of the book The Intuitions Age: Creative Intuitionism & Reclaiming Knowledge in a Post-AI World: Toward a New Epistemology, deposited to ensure authorship, DOI assignment, and academic visibility.

The book introduces Creative Intuitionism, an original philosophical framework that reclaims intuition as a rigorous, generative, and perceptually structured form of knowledge-making, and Intuitional Echo Mapping (IEM), a methodological practice for sensing weak signals and emergent patterns.

Emerging at the intersection of philosophy, futures studies, design, and cultural epistemologies, the work critiques algorithmic rationality and proposes intuition, resonance, and symbolic depth as vital epistemic tools in a post-AI world.

AI.tldr: 本书提出了创造性直觉主义哲学框架和直觉回声映射方法，旨在后AI时代重新确立直觉作为严谨知识生成工具的地位，批判算法理性并强调直觉、共鸣和符号深度的重要性。
AI.research_question: 在后AI时代，如何重新确立直觉作为一种严谨、生成性和感知结构化的知识生成形式？
AI.motivation: 批判算法理性的局限性，在人工智能主导的时代重新发现和系统化直觉作为重要认知工具的价值
AI.theoretical_framework: 创造性直觉主义（Creative Intuitionism） - 将直觉重新定义为严谨的、生成性的、感知结构化的知识生成形式
AI.method: 直觉回声映射（Intuitional Echo Mapping, IEM） - 用于感知弱信号和涌现模式的方法论实践
AI.findings: 直觉、共鸣和符号深度是后AI时代至关重要的认知工具，能够弥补算法理性的不足
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了创造性直觉主义这一原创哲学框架，为直觉在知识论中的地位提供了系统化的理论支撑
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了直觉回声映射这一具体方法论工具，帮助人们在实际中更好地感知弱信号和识别涌现模式

title: Empowering Adoption: Experimental Evidence on Nutritional Seeds Uptake by Ethiopian Women Farmers
affiliations: Haramaya University, University of Groningen - Department of Economics, Econometrics and Finance, Economie and University of Groningen

detail.title: Empowering Adoption: Experimental Evidence on Nutritional Seeds Uptake by Ethiopian Women Farmers
detail.abstract: Despite its significant nutritional benefits, the adoption of Quality Protein Maize (QPM)-a biofortified maize variety rich in lysine and tryptophan-remains low across sub-Saharan Africa. This paper investigates whether psychosocial constraints hinder adoption among smallholder farmers. We conduct a randomized controlled trial with 1,200 female smallholders in Ethiopia to evaluate the impact of a psychosocial training intervention-targeting self-esteem, goal setting, and social capital-on willingness to pay (WTP) for QPM seeds. We elicit WTP through a Becker-DeGroot-Marschak (BDM) auction with randomly assigned strike prices to simulate varying subsidy levels. We find that the training significantly increases both stated WTP and actual adoption: treated participants bid 5.42% higher and were 6.2% more likely to purchase QPM seeds. We further compare the cost-effectiveness of the training to that of a direct seed subsidy, finding that the psychosocial intervention yields comparable uptake effects equivalent to additional subsidy of 30 Birr per participant. These findings highlight the role of internal psychological barriers in shaping agricultural investment decisions and suggest that non-financial interventions can complement traditional subsidy programs to improve uptake of health-enhancing technologies in low-income settings.

AI.tldr: 本文通过随机对照试验发现，针对自尊、目标设定和社会资本的心理社会培训干预能显著提高埃塞俄比亚小农户对优质蛋白玉米(QPM)的支付意愿和实际采用率，效果相当于每人30比尔的补贴，表明心理障碍是影响农业技术采用的重要因素。
AI.research_question: 心理社会约束是否会阻碍小农户采用优质蛋白玉米(QPM)？
AI.motivation: 尽管优质蛋白玉米具有重要营养益处，但在撒哈拉以南非洲地区的采用率仍然很低，需要探究心理社会因素是否构成采用障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和心理学理论，关注自我效能、社会资本和心理障碍对技术采用决策的影响。
AI.method: 在埃塞俄比亚对1200名女性小农户进行随机对照试验，使用Becker-DeGroot-Marschak拍卖机制测量支付意愿，比较心理社会培训干预与直接种子补贴的效果。
AI.findings: 培训干预显著提高了5.42%的支付意愿和6.2%的实际购买可能性，心理干预效果相当于每人30比尔的补贴。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了内部心理障碍在农业投资决策中的重要作用，拓展了技术采用理论的心理社会维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明非财务干预可以补充传统补贴计划，为提高低收入环境中健康增强技术的采用提供了成本有效的替代方案。

title: The Role of Accounting Information for Public Mass Transit Systems in Addressing Polycrisis Risks
affiliations: University of Virginia - Weldon Cooper Center for Public Service

detail.title: The Role of Accounting Information for Public Mass Transit Systems in Addressing Polycrisis Risks
detail.abstract: In the United States, the U.S. Bureau of Economic analysis reports that state and local governments (subnational) own 80 percent of all reported public sector fixed assets 1. This includes buildings, roads and bridges, water and sewer lines, parks and recreational facilities, mass transit systems and other elements. These governmental fixed assets are crucial in driving the economic flows of the $30 trillion U.S. economy. Mass transit systems, as one element of these fixed assets, are improving regional economic development, addressing climate change, economic competitiveness and overall human wellbeing. Simultaneously, these very economic, social and environmental factors pose risks to the operations and viability of these systems. These systems face a tremendous amount of fiscal stress caused by a number of factors including the post pandemic economy, commuting patterns and other social conditions. The system also faces other risks such as the impact of clime change such as extreme heat and flooding that would impact service provision and possibly impose much higher maintenance costs over time. This paper will be divided into several sections. Section one will be in introductory and background section. Part one of section one will highlight the importance the overall role of government fixed and the current of accounting reporting. The next part of section one will focus on the role of mass transit in the overall fixed asset system and any unique accounting challenges in this sector. Section two will provide a conceptual framework for how we can thing about the overall role of financial and sustainability accounting in the mass transit system. This framework will directly assess how accounting information can be used in vulnerability and resiliency analysis beyond the traditional financial and operational metrics. The goal is to develop a normative conceptual framework with a specific set of criteria from which we can judge and assess the ability of the current accounting statements, in a general sense, to inform decision makers and stakeholders regarding the financial, operational and environmental risks facing mass transit systems. The other point of emphasis will be in the framework and reporting that comes out mass transit systems and whether such information meets the informational needs of the various stakeholders in these systems. Section three will be focused on a case study of the Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority as a case study for the conceptual framework developed in section two. The Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority (WMATA) is the case study focus of this study and how is implementing and using accounting practices to address these multiple problems. WMATA is the system that serves as the rail and bus system form the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area and it is the second largest system in the United States. Moody’s and standard and Poor’s; have retained a negative of the credit rating for WMATA. The WMATA is a unique government agency in that it is an interstate/federal compact between The United States government, the Commonwealth of Virginia, the State of Maryland and the Washington District of Columbia government.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国公共交通系统的财务和可持续性会计框架，重点关注会计信息如何用于脆弱性和韧性分析，并以华盛顿都会区交通局为案例进行研究。
AI.research_question: 如何通过会计信息来评估和应对公共交通系统面临的财务、运营和环境风险？
AI.motivation: 美国州和地方政府拥有80%的公共部门固定资产，其中公共交通系统对经济发展至关重要，但面临疫情后经济、气候变化等多重压力，需要新的会计框架来应对这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财务与可持续性会计框架，将传统财务指标与环境风险分析相结合，为公共交通系统提供综合风险评估工具。
AI.method: 采用规范性概念框架开发和案例研究法，以华盛顿都会区交通局（WMATA）为具体案例进行分析。
AI.findings: 需要开发新的会计框架来更好地反映公共交通系统面临的多重风险，传统财务报表无法充分满足利益相关者的信息需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将财务会计与可持续性会计相结合的概念框架，扩展了会计信息在公共部门风险管理中的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共交通系统提供了具体的会计实践指导，帮助决策者更好地评估和管理财务、运营和环境风险，提高系统韧性。

title: The Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive: A Law & Economics Evaluation
affiliations: The Hadar Jabotinsky Center for Interdisciplinary Research of Financial Markets, Crises and Technology (HJC) and Institute of Law and Economics, University of Hamburg

detail.title: The Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive: A Law & Economics Evaluation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: nothing to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: Nothing to declare
declarations.funderStatement: The research was funded by the University of Hamburg (excellence cluster)

detail.abstract: The Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CS3D), adopted by the European Union in June 2024, represents an ambitious regulatory experiment that transforms large corporations into gatekeepers of sustainable supply chains. This paper provides a comprehensive Law & Economics analysis of the CS3D, revealing several overlooked incentive problems that may undermine its effectiveness. We identify environmental harm and human rights violations as "public bads" requiring intervention, but demonstrate that the CS3D's mechanisms may create perverse outcomes. Through transaction cost analysis, we further show how the directive may inefficiently allocate monitoring responsibilities. The analysis further reveals risks of both over-deterrence and under-deterrence arising from the problematic combination of regulatory fines and civil liability. Most concerning, we document multiple unintended consequences: chilling effects that may drive firms from markets, a statistical discrimination problem that could harm the very populations the directive aims to protect, higher prices, potential competition effects, and rent-seeking costs due to circumvention attempts.  Our analysis suggests that without careful calibration, the CS3D may trade one set of market failures for another, potentially harming both economic efficiency and the vulnerable populations it seeks to protect.

AI.tldr: 欧盟CS3D指令旨在通过大企业监管供应链可持续性，但存在激励问题、监管效率低下、过度威慑与威慑不足并存等风险，可能产生意外后果并损害经济效率和目标人群。
AI.research_question: 欧盟《企业可持续发展尽职调查指令》(CS3D)在监管大型企业供应链可持续性方面存在哪些激励问题和效率缺陷？
AI.motivation: CS3D指令作为欧盟2024年通过的雄心勃勃的监管实验，试图将大企业转变为可持续供应链的守门人，但其潜在激励问题和有效性风险尚未得到充分分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律与经济学分析框架，运用公共物品理论（将环境损害和人权侵犯视为"公共恶品"）和交易成本理论
AI.method: 理论分析法，通过法律经济学视角进行制度分析和激励结构评估
AI.findings: CS3D机制可能产生逆向结果，监控责任分配效率低下，监管罚款与民事责任的问题组合导致过度威慑和威慑不足风险，并产生多重意外后果
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了强制性供应链监管中的激励冲突问题，为监管设计提供了重要的理论洞见
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了CS3D指令实施过程中需要警惕的风险和需要精细校准的建议，以避免用一套市场失灵替换另一套市场失灵

title: The Economic, Demographic, and Institutional Foundations of Trade Liberalization in Pakistan: An Econometric and Machine Learning Analysis
affiliations: National Research University – Higher School of Economics (HSE University)

detail.title: The Economic, Demographic, and Institutional Foundations of Trade Liberalization in Pakistan: An Econometric and Machine Learning Analysis
detail.abstract: Developing economies face persistent challenges integrating into global trade, shaped by complex economic, demographic, and institutional interactions. This study investigates these multifaceted determinants of trade openness in Pakistan from 1990-2024, employing a robust mixed-methods approach that integrates advanced econometrics with machine learning. Unit root tests revealed a mix of stationary and non-stationary series, justifying the use of an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model. Cointegration was confirmed via Johansen and ARDL Bounds tests, and an Error Correction Model (ECM) captured dynamics. To address endogeneity, Instrumental Variables (IV-2SLS) and Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) estimators were applied, while machine learning models (LASSO, Random Forest, SVR) explored non-linearities. The results confirm long-run cointegration among trade and its determinants. Gross capital formation (GCF) was a consistently positive and significant driver, though its effect is constrained by limited foreign direct investment. Conversely, human capital deficiencies (proxied by services value-added) showed a significant negative impact, reflecting skills mismatches that limit competitiveness. Institutional quality, particularly government effectiveness, also negatively impacted trade, highlighting governance weaknesses as a major non-tariff barrier. Inflation had a positive relationship with trade, suggesting liberalization may exacerbate price pressures. The ECM indicated a rapid, potentially volatile adjustment to equilibrium. Machine learning (SVR performed best) reinforced the dominance of economic factors like GCF and inflation, while demographic and institutional variables showed weaker contributions, likely due to data limitations. Pakistan's trade is constrained by low human capital, weak institutions, and macroeconomic imbalances, validating an integrated theoretical framework. Policies must boost investment through FDI, enhance education and vocational training to leverage labor abundance, and implement governance reforms to reduce transaction costs. Macroeconomic stability requires coordinated fiscal and monetary policy. This study contributes a novel methodological framework combining econometrics and machine learning, offering a replicable model for analyzing trade dynamics in developing economies. Future research should utilize sectoral data, incorporate sustainability metrics and extend the analysis for comparative regional insights.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用计量经济学与机器学习相结合的方法，分析了巴基斯坦1990-2024年贸易开放度的多维度决定因素，发现资本形成、人力资本不足、制度质量和通胀等因素对贸易有显著影响，并提出了相应的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦贸易开放度的多维度决定因素是什么？这些因素如何影响该国的全球贸易整合？
AI.motivation: 发展中经济体在全球贸易整合中面临持续挑战，需要深入理解经济、人口和制度等多重因素的复杂交互作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合理论框架，整合经济因素（资本形成、通胀）、人力资本因素（服务增加值）、制度因素（政府效能）等多维度变量。
AI.method: 混合方法：使用ARDL模型、Johansen和ARDL边界检验、ECM模型处理内生性问题（IV-2SLS、GMM），并结合机器学习模型（LASSO、随机森林、SVR）探索非线性关系。
AI.findings: 1. 资本形成（GCF）是持续正向驱动因素但受FDI限制；2. 人力资本不足对贸易有显著负面影响；3. 制度质量（政府效能）负面影响贸易；4. 通胀与贸易正相关；5. ECM显示快速但可能波动的均衡调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合计量经济学和机器学习的创新方法论框架，为分析发展中经济体的贸易动态提供了可复制的模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策建议包括：通过FDI促进投资、加强教育和职业培训以利用劳动力优势、实施治理改革降低交易成本、协调财政和货币政策确保宏观经济稳定。

title:
Sharia and Secular Law: A Framework for Legal Pluralism 
A Proposal for Integrating Faith-Based Justice within Secular Societies
affiliations: Federal University of Agriculture

detail.title:
Sharia and Secular Law: A Framework for Legal Pluralism 
A Proposal for Integrating Faith-Based Justice within Secular Societies
detail.abstract: This proposal presents a framework for integrating a Sharia justice system within an existing secular legal structure. The purpose is to respect religious diversity, safeguard Muslim legal autonomy, and strengthen national unity without undermining constitutional principles. The model emphasizes that Sharia is not intended as a replacement of secular law but as a complementary system applicable exclusively to Muslims in matters of family, inheritance, morality, religious obligations, and community welfare. The proposal outlines a dual judicial structure where Sharia courts operate alongside secular courts, supported by a Muslim registration system, zakat administration, and a Sharia enforcement unit within the police. It also recommends conflict resolution mechanisms, constitutional safeguards, and capacity-building initiatives to ensure efficiency and prevent jurisdictional overlap. To address misconceptions, the proposal clarifies the moral foundation of Sharia, highlighting its focus on justice, prevention of crime, accountability, and community welfare. By incorporating international human rights standards, particularly freedom of religion and legal inclusion, the framework ensures that fundamental rights are protected while allowing Muslims to live according to their religious convictions. Implementation is envisioned in phases, beginning with pilot programs in Muslim-majority regions, followed by gradual nationwide integration. Ultimately, the proposal seeks to create a balanced and inclusive justice system that upholds fairness, reduces interfaith tension, and enhances public trust in governance.

AI.tldr: 该提案提出了一个在现有世俗法律体系内整合伊斯兰教法司法系统的框架，旨在尊重宗教多样性、保障穆斯林法律自治，同时不削弱宪法原则。该模型强调伊斯兰教法不是要取代世俗法律，而是作为补充系统，专门适用于穆斯林在家庭、继承、道德、宗教义务和社区福利方面的事务。
AI.research_question: 如何在保持宪法原则的前提下，将伊斯兰教法司法系统整合到世俗法律体系中，以尊重宗教多样性和保障穆斯林法律自治？
AI.motivation: 尊重宗教多样性，保障穆斯林群体的法律自治权，在不破坏宪法原则的基础上加强国家统一，减少宗教间紧张关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于法律多元主义理论，结合宗教自由和人权保护原则，构建世俗法律与宗教法律并存的司法框架。
AI.method: 提出双轨司法结构模型，包括伊斯兰教法法庭与世俗法庭并行运作，配套穆斯林登记系统、天课管理制度和警察内部的教法执法单位。
AI.findings: 通过分阶段实施（从穆斯林多数地区试点到全国推广），建立冲突解决机制和宪法保障措施，可以实现两种法律体系的和谐共存。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了法律多元主义理论在宗教法律整合中的应用，提出了世俗与宗教法律系统协调运作的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多宗教国家提供了可行的法律整合实施方案，包括具体的机构设置、冲突解决机制和权利保障措施，有助于减少宗教冲突和增强政府公信力。

title: AI and National Competitiveness: Legal and Policy Pathways for U.S. Tech Leadership
affiliations: George Washington University - School of Business

detail.title: AI and National Competitiveness: Legal and Policy Pathways for U.S. Tech Leadership
detail.abstract: The world is quickly demonstrating that artificial intelligence is changing the global economic power, military capabilities, and strategic influence. The US has been a global technological leader. Still, it is currently confronted by increasing challenges posed by China and the European Union, which are developing broad AI governance and industrial policies. The paper begins by tracking the recent development of AI policy in the United States since the Trump administration. It examines federal and state-level policies through the lens of computer governance, export controls, and regulatory coordination. It measures the combination of industrial policy, security protection, and incentives to innovate based on comparative policy analysis. It identifies opportunities to enhance U.S. policy on research investment, talent development, and harmonized governance structures. The results show that export restrictions are still primarily focused on tangible items, and there is no regulation of cloud and computer access. Fragmented state policies also weaken strategic coherence across the country. Based on global comparisons and U.S. policy review, the paper suggests specific reforms, such as requiring federal computer licensing, applying export regulations to cloud-based services, developing a model AI regulation regime to be used by states, strengthening research incentives, and investing in the development of the workforce. Harmonized together, these actions would bolster the country's overall innovation potential, seal significant security gaps, and make the United States a global benchmark in AI regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国AI政策发展，指出其在出口管制、云计算监管和州级政策协调方面的不足，提出了联邦计算机许可、云服务出口管制、统一AI监管框架等改革建议，以提升美国创新能力和全球AI监管领导地位。
AI.research_question: 美国AI政策在应对全球竞争和技术变革方面存在哪些关键挑战？如何通过政策改革来增强美国的创新能力和全球领导地位？
AI.motivation: 人工智能正在重塑全球经济、军事和战略格局，美国面临中国和欧盟在AI治理和产业政策方面的挑战，需要评估和改进现有政策以保持竞争优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于比较政策分析框架，结合产业政策、安全保护和创新激励理论，从计算机治理、出口管制和监管协调三个维度分析AI政策。
AI.method: 通过追踪特朗普政府以来的美国AI政策发展，分析联邦和州级政策，采用比较政策分析方法评估产业政策、安全保护和创新激励的组合效果。
AI.findings: 出口限制主要针对有形物品，缺乏对云计算和计算机访问的监管；分散的州级政策削弱了国家战略一致性；需要加强研究投资、人才培养和统一治理结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI政策分析的多维度框架，丰富了比较政策分析在新兴技术治理领域的应用，为AI政策研究提供了理论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体政策改革建议：联邦计算机许可制度、云服务出口管制、统一州级AI监管框架、加强研究激励和人才培养，这些措施可提升美国创新潜力、填补安全漏洞并建立全球AI监管标杆。

title: Legal Regulation of Generative AI and Copyright: U.S. Experience and Prospects for Kazakhstan
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Legal Regulation of Generative AI and Copyright: U.S. Experience and Prospects for Kazakhstan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.

declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The rapid development of generative artificial intelligence (AI) has unsettled long-standing assumptions in copyright law. While the United States has been at the forefront of testing authorship, originality, and fair use boundaries through both litigation and administrative policy, Kazakhstan remains at the early stages of conceptualizing a legal response. This article undertakes a comparative legal analysis of U.S. copyright jurisprudence, administrative guidance, and scholarly debate, and examines their applicability to Kazakhstan's emerging innovation ecosystem. By analyzing case law (Thaler v. Vidal, Thaler v. Perlmutter, Andy Warhol Foundation v. Goldsmith), international frameworks (TRIPS, Berne Convention, WIPO reports), and Kazakhstan's copyright legislation, the article identifies gaps, doctrinal controversies, and potential reforms. It argues that Kazakhstan should proactively adopt a hybrid approach, integrating U.S. lessons while adapting to domestic realities such as weak enforcement, underdeveloped startup ecosystems, and the need for harmonization with international commitments.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较美国版权法实践与哈萨克斯坦法律现状，探讨生成式AI对版权法的挑战，建议哈萨克斯坦采取混合式法律改革路径
AI.research_question: 哈萨克斯坦应如何应对生成式人工智能对版权法带来的挑战，借鉴美国经验并适应本国国情？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的快速发展动摇了版权法的传统假设，美国通过诉讼和政策测试了作者身份、原创性和合理使用边界，而哈萨克斯坦尚处于法律回应的早期阶段
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较法律分析框架，结合美国版权判例法、行政指导和学术辩论，以及国际框架（TRIPS、伯尔尼公约、WIPO报告）
AI.method: 比较法律分析方法，分析美国案例法（Thaler v. Vidal, Thaler v. Perlmutter, Andy Warhol Foundation v. Goldsmith）和哈萨克斯坦版权立法
AI.findings: 识别了哈萨克斯坦法律体系中的空白、理论争议和潜在改革需求，发现需要协调国际承诺与国内实施能力
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了混合式法律改革理论框架，强调在借鉴国际经验的同时适应本土现实
AI.practical_contributions: 为哈萨克斯坦政策制定者提供了具体的法律改革建议，包括加强执法、发展初创生态系统和协调国际承诺

title: Detecting and Modeling Bubble Dynamics in Industrial Metals Markets
affiliations: Florida Southern College and All Saints Academy

detail.title: Detecting and Modeling Bubble Dynamics in Industrial Metals Markets
detail.abstract: This study examines speculative bubbles and their dynamic interactions in the prices of key industrial metals: aluminum, copper, and iron ore. Using the Supremum Augmented Dickey-Fuller (SADF) and Generalized SADF (GSADF) tests, we identify periods of explosive price behavior indicative of bubbles, based on the stationarity properties of asset prices and their fundamentals. The Dynamic Conditional Correlation Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity (DCC-GARCH) model is employed to analyze the time-varying dynamics of these bubbles across the metals. Our findings reveal multiple episodes of price exuberance in aluminum, copper, and iron ore, with the strongest correlations among bubble periods observed during the lead-up to the 2008 financial crisis. We also contextualize these results by comparing them to oil price bubbles. This research enhances the understanding of speculative dynamics in commodity markets, offering valuable insights for investors, policymakers, and risk managers.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用SADF和GSADF检验识别铝、铜和铁矿石价格中的投机泡沫，并通过DCC-GARCH模型分析泡沫的时变动态。发现2008年金融危机前泡沫相关性最强，并与石油价格泡沫进行比较。
AI.research_question: 工业金属（铝、铜、铁矿石）价格中是否存在投机泡沫？这些泡沫在不同金属之间如何动态互动？
AI.motivation: 理解大宗商品市场中投机泡沫的形成和互动机制，为投资者、政策制定者和风险管理者提供有价值的见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产价格与其基本面的平稳性特性，使用理性泡沫理论框架来识别和分析投机泡沫。
AI.method: 使用Supremum Augmented Dickey-Fuller (SADF) 和 Generalized SADF (GSADF) 检验识别泡沫期，采用Dynamic Conditional Correlation GARCH (DCC-GARCH) 模型分析泡沫的时变动态相关性。
AI.findings: 在铝、铜和铁矿石价格中发现多个投机泡沫期，2008年金融危机前的泡沫期相关性最强；与石油价格泡沫的比较提供了额外的背景信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了投机泡沫理论在工业金属市场的应用，提供了泡沫动态互动的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商品市场投资者提供泡沫识别和风险管理工具，为政策制定者提供市场监管参考，帮助风险管理者更好地理解和管理大宗商品价格风险。

title: Structural-Multifractional Rough Volatility (SMR) Model
affiliations: University of Strathclyde

detail.title: Structural-Multifractional Rough Volatility (SMR) Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
We introduce the Structural–Multifractional Rough (SMR) volatility model, a theoretically grounded yet practically tractable extension of the rough Bergomi framework. The model endogenizes the forward variance surface as a convex combination of a finite set of spectral bands with stochastic Wright–Fisher weights (generalized Jacobi processes), ensuring both boundedness and economic interpretability. Over this structural layer, we superimpose a parsimonious multifractional rough component, constructed from a finite basis of Volterra drivers with time-dependent coefficients, so that the effective Hurst index varies dynamically across horizons. For the finite-dimensional formulation, we establish strong existence and uniqueness of solutions, strict positivity of variance, and convergence of the basis approximation toward a continuum multifractional representation. The discounted asset price is always a local martingale, and we provide explicit remedies such as truncating the exponential factor or adopting additive positive formulations that guarantee the true-martingale (no-arbitrage) property.

Importantly, the classical rough Bergomi model emerges as a special case of SMR, corresponding to a single spectral band with deterministic weights and a fixed Hurst parameter. This nesting property situates SMR as a natural generalization rather than an ad hoc modification, ensuring continuity with established rough volatility theory.

By unifying structural variance decompositions with multifractional roughness, the SMR model delivers both mathematical rigor and practical usability. It is straightforward to simulate, calibrate, and apply in option-surface analysis, positioning SMR as a powerful next-generation framework for understanding implied-volatility dynamics.

AI.tldr: SMR波动率模型是粗糙Bergomi框架的理论扩展，通过结构化方差分解和多分形粗糙度统一，实现了数学严谨性和实践可用性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个既具有理论基础又便于实践的波动率模型，能够内生地描述远期方差表面并动态调整Hurst指数？
AI.motivation: 传统粗糙波动率模型在解释市场波动率表面的复杂动态时存在局限性，需要更灵活的框架来捕捉多尺度的波动特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于粗糙Bergomi框架，结合结构化方差分解（谱带随机权重）和多分形粗糙成分（时变系数的Volterra驱动基）。
AI.method: 构建SMR模型的理论框架，证明强解存在唯一性、方差严格正性、基近似收敛性，并确保无套利性质。
AI.findings: SMR模型成功统一了结构方差分解和多分形粗糙度，能够动态调整Hurst指数，且经典粗糙Bergomi模型是其特例。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了理论严谨的SMR模型框架，建立了有限维表述的数学性质，扩展了粗糙波动率理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 模型易于模拟、校准和应用于期权表面分析，为理解隐含波动率动态提供了新一代强大框架。

title: From Legislation to Implementation: Waste and Air Pollution Control in Bangladesh under International Standards
affiliations: Private University

detail.title: From Legislation to Implementation: Waste and Air Pollution Control in Bangladesh under International Standards
detail.abstract: Bangladesh faces an escalating environmental crisis driven by rapid urbanization, industrial growth, and inadequate waste management. Unregulated disposal of solid and hazardous waste, alongside rising vehicular and industrial emissions, has caused severe air pollution, particularly in urban centers such as Dhaka, Chittagong, and Narayanganj. This paper critically examines the legal and institutional frameworks governing environmental protection, waste management, and air quality in Bangladesh. Judicial interventions highlight the constitutional right to a healthy environment and the judiciary's role in addressing enforcement gaps. Despite a comprehensive legal framework, enforcement is inconsistent due to administrative weaknesses, limited technical capacity, and political interference, resulting in continued environmental degradation and public health risks. The study situates Bangladesh's challenges within an international context, analyzing compliance with treaties such as the Paris Agreement and the Convention on Biological Diversity, and drawing lessons from global jurisprudence, including Mexico v. USA, to enhance domestic accountability and preventive governance. The paper proposes actionable recommendations, including strengthening institutional capacity, enforcing Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR), raising public awareness, implementing data-driven monitoring systems, and aligning national standards with WHO air quality guidelines and ISO 14001 environmental management frameworks. By integrating legislative rigor, judicial oversight, administrative efficiency, and international best practices, this study offers a roadmap for sustainable environmental governance in Bangladesh, aiming to mitigate air pollution, improve waste management, protect public health, and ensure long-term ecological resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了孟加拉国环境治理的法律和制度框架，指出尽管有全面的法律体系，但由于行政薄弱、技术能力有限和政治干预，执法不一致导致持续的环境退化和公共健康风险。研究提出了加强机构能力、执行生产者责任延伸、提高公众意识等可行建议，为孟加拉国可持续环境治理提供路线图。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国环境治理的法律和制度框架如何应对快速城市化、工业增长和废物管理不足带来的环境危机？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国面临由快速城市化、工业增长和废物管理不足驱动的日益严重的环境危机，未经管制的固体和危险废物处置以及不断增加的车辆和工业排放导致严重空气污染，特别是在达卡、吉大港和纳拉扬甘杰等城市中心。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法环境权理论、国际环境法框架（巴黎协定、生物多样性公约）、全球法理学（如墨西哥诉美国案）、预防性治理理论、生产者责任延伸理论
AI.method: 法律和制度框架的批判性分析、司法干预研究、国际条约合规性分析、比较法研究（借鉴全球法理学）
AI.findings: 尽管有全面的法律框架，但执法不一致导致持续环境退化；司法干预强调了健康环境权的重要性；行政薄弱、技术能力有限和政治干扰是主要障碍
AI.theory_contributions: 将孟加拉国的挑战置于国际背景下分析，整合立法严谨性、司法监督、行政效率和国际最佳实践，为环境治理提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体可行的建议：加强机构能力、执行EPR、提高公众意识、实施数据驱动的监测系统、使国家标准与WHO空气质量指南和ISO 14001框架保持一致

title: Five Facts About the First-Generation Excellence Gap
affiliations: Columbia University, University of Chicago - Department of Economics, University of Virginia and University of Chicago, Department of Economics, Students

detail.title: Five Facts About the First-Generation Excellence Gap
detail.abstract:
Parents are crucial to children’s educational success, but the role of parental education in fostering academic excellence remains underexplored. Using longitudinal administrative data covering all North Carolina public school students, we document five facts about first-generation excellence gaps. We find large excellence gaps emerge by 3rd grade across all demographics and persist through high school. Yet, socioeconomic status and school quality explain only one-third of the gaps. The overarching facts reveal that excellence gaps re-flect deeper challenges rooted in parental human capital that manifest early and compound over time, rather than merely consequences of socioeconomic disadvantage or school quality differences.

AI.tldr: 研究发现卓越差距（学业优秀学生与普通学生之间的差距）在小学三年级就已显现并持续到高中，社会经济地位和学校质量只能解释其中三分之一的原因，主要根源在于父母人力资本的差异
AI.research_question: 父母教育背景如何影响子女学业卓越差距的形成和持续？
AI.motivation: 父母对子女教育成功至关重要，但父母教育在培养学业卓越方面的作用尚未得到充分探索
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、教育不平等理论、代际传递理论
AI.method: 使用北卡罗来纳州所有公立学校学生的纵向行政数据进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1) 卓越差距在三年级就已显现；2) 在所有人口统计群体中都存在；3) 持续到高中阶段；4) 社会经济地位和学校质量只能解释三分之一的差距；5) 主要根源在于父母人力资本差异
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了卓越差距的深层机制，强调父母人力资本而非仅仅是社会经济地位或学校质量差异的作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定提供新视角，建议早期干预和针对父母人力资本的支持措施

title: Should States Reduce Teacher Licensing Requirements? Evidence from the Rise of For-Profit Training Programs in Texas
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas and Cornell University, Department of Economics

detail.title: Should States Reduce Teacher Licensing Requirements? Evidence from the Rise of For-Profit Training Programs in Texas
detail.abstract:
We provide a comprehensive analysis of a Texas policy that relaxed teacher licensing requirements and created a large for-profit training industry. Using detailed administrative data, we show that for-profit-trained teachers have higher turnover and lower value-added than standard-trained teachers. But the policy significantly increased the supply of certified teachers, reducing schools' reliance on uncertified teachers with even worse outcomes. Exploiting variation in policy exposure across schools, we find a zero net impact on student achievement due to these offsetting forces. Thus lower licensing requirements improved access to teaching and reduced training costs without harming students.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 德克萨斯州放宽教师资格认证要求的政策虽然降低了教师培训成本并增加了合格教师供给，但营利性培训机构培养的教师质量较差、流失率较高。由于同时减少了学校对无证教师的依赖，学生学业成就整体上没有受到影响。
AI.research_question: 放宽教师资格认证要求对教师质量、供给和学生学业成就有何影响？
AI.motivation: 分析德克萨斯州放宽教师资格认证要求的政策效果，评估其对教师市场和学生学业的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 教师劳动力市场理论、教育政策评估理论、人力资本理论
AI.method: 使用详细的行政数据，利用学校间政策暴露程度的差异进行因果推断分析
AI.findings: 营利性培训机构培养的教师流失率更高、增值效果更低，但政策显著增加了合格教师供给，减少了对表现更差的无证教师的依赖，学生学业成就整体上没有受到影响
AI.theory_contributions: 为教师资格认证政策的效果提供了实证证据，揭示了政策对教师质量和供给的权衡关系
AI.practical_contributions: 政策制定者可以参考此研究结果，在放宽教师资格要求与保证教育质量之间找到平衡点

title: Latent Polarization
affiliations: Southern Methodist University (SMU),  and UCLA Anderson School of Management

detail.title: Latent Polarization
detail.abstract:
We develop a new method to endogenously partition society into groups based on homophily in values, using fractional hedonic games as a theoretical foundation. The between-group differentiation that results from this partition provides a novel measure of latent polarization in society. We implement this method empirically using U.S. data from the World Values Survey. For the last forty years, the degree of latent polarization of the U.S. public has been high and relatively stable. In contrast, the degree of values polarization between voters of the two main political parties has steadily increased since the 1990s, and is now converging toward that of underlying values-based clusters. Thus, growing partisan polarization in the U.S. is a reflection of partisan views becoming increasingly aligned with the main values-based clusters in society.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于价值同质性的社会群体划分新方法，使用分数享乐博弈作为理论基础。该方法测量了美国社会潜在的价值观极化程度，发现过去40年社会潜在极化程度高且稳定，而政党间的价值观极化自1990年代以来持续增长，现已趋近于基于价值观的潜在群体分化程度。
AI.research_question: 如何测量美国社会的潜在价值观极化程度？政党间价值观极化与社会潜在价值观极化之间的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 需要开发一种能够内生性地基于价值同质性划分社会群体的方法，以更好地理解和测量社会极化现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分数享乐博弈理论（Fractional Hedonic Games）作为理论基础，用于基于价值同质性进行社会群体划分。
AI.method: 使用世界价值观调查（World Values Survey）的美国数据，应用基于分数享乐博弈的新方法来内生性地划分社会群体并测量极化程度。
AI.findings: 1. 过去40年美国社会的潜在价值观极化程度高且相对稳定；2. 自1990年代以来，两大政党选民间的价值观极化程度稳步增长；3. 政党间价值观极化现已趋近于基于价值观的潜在群体分化程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于分数享乐博弈的社会群体划分新方法，为测量社会潜在极化提供了新的理论框架和度量工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和社会科学家提供了测量和分析社会极化的实用工具，有助于理解美国政治极化现象的本质和趋势。

title: Regulating Biological Resources: Lessons From Marine Fisheries in the United States
affiliations: University of Chicago and University of Delaware

detail.title: Regulating Biological Resources: Lessons From Marine Fisheries in the United States
detail.abstract:
In 1996, with United States fish populations in decline, Congress overhauled fishing laws with scientific thresholds for rebuilding overfished stocks. The law's impact is contested, and lawmakers have spent over a decade debating its reauthorization while countries around the world consider similar policies. We develop the first causally interpretable evaluation of this law, exploiting the fact that the European Union has comparable fisheries but only recently developed similar laws. Compiling comprehensive data on US and EU fishery status and management, we examine fish populations that decline to unhealthy levels and measure the effect of a policy that aims to rebuild them to health. We find treated populations increase by 52 percent relative to these counterfactuals, with both catch and revenue rebounding to baseline levels or greater. Analyzing fisheries' revenue, we find net present values are higher for at least 69 percent of rebuilt stocks compared to simulated counterfactuals.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对美国1996年渔业法律改革进行了因果性评估，通过比较美国与欧盟渔业管理差异，发现受政策影响的鱼类种群数量增加了52%，捕捞量和收入也恢复到基线水平或更高。
AI.research_question: 美国1996年渔业法律改革对重建过度捕捞鱼类种群的实际效果如何？
AI.motivation: 美国鱼类种群数量下降，国会通过科学阈值重建过度捕捞种群的法律，但其影响存在争议，且世界各国正在考虑类似政策，需要实证评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政策评估的因果推断理论，利用欧盟作为对照组进行准实验设计。
AI.method: 编译美国和欧盟渔业状况和管理的综合数据，利用欧盟作为自然对照组，分析种群衰退至不健康水平的鱼类，测量政策对重建效果的影响。
AI.findings: 受政策处理的种群数量相对对照组增加了52%，捕捞量和收入恢复到基线水平或更高，至少69%的重建种群净现值高于模拟对照组。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了首个对美国渔业法律改革的因果性评估方法，为类似政策评估建立了实证分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了科学证据支持渔业管理政策的有效性，为全球各国考虑类似渔业政策提供了参考依据。

title: Revealing Domestic Abuse Realities and Viable Helpseeking Pathways for South Asian Women in Scotland Research Briefing 2 Domestic Living Arrangements and Kinship Structures
affiliations: University of Glasgow, University of Glasgow and University of Glasgow

detail.title: Revealing Domestic Abuse Realities and Viable Helpseeking Pathways for South Asian Women in Scotland Research Briefing 2 Domestic Living Arrangements and Kinship Structures
detail.abstract: Despite evidence of severe, culturally specific patterns of abuse and persistent barriers to support, little research has focused on the experiences of South Asian women in Scotland or how they understand and seek help for domestic abuse. Diversifying Justice addressed this gap through arts-based focus groups (n=15) and narrative interviews (n=14), conducted in Urdu and English, using a feminist, participatory methodology designed to prioritise care, reciprocity, and safe sharing of experiences. This briefing focuses on domestic living arrangements and kinship structures. Participants described multigenerational affinal households where mothers-in-law and extended relatives often directed or escalated abuse, alongside natal homes marked by intergenerational trauma and violence. Reproductive control, household hierarchies, and family interference limited autonomy and normalised abuse. Findings underscore the need for culturally sensitive responses that take account of kinship dynamics beyond spousal relationships.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过艺术焦点小组和叙事访谈探讨苏格兰南亚女性遭受家庭暴力的独特文化模式，发现姻亲家庭结构和亲属关系是虐待的重要影响因素，强调需要文化敏感的干预措施。
AI.research_question: 苏格兰南亚女性如何理解和寻求家庭暴力帮助？姻亲家庭结构和亲属关系在家庭暴力中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 尽管有证据表明南亚女性遭受严重的、文化特定的虐待模式，且在获取支持方面存在持续障碍，但针对苏格兰南亚女性经历的研究很少
AI.theoretical_framework: 女性主义参与式方法论，强调关怀、互惠和安全分享体验
AI.method: 艺术基础焦点小组（15人）和叙事访谈（14人），使用乌尔都语和英语进行
AI.findings: 参与者描述了多代姻亲家庭中婆婆和扩展亲属经常主导或升级虐待；原生家庭存在代际创伤和暴力；生育控制、家庭等级和家庭干预限制了自主权并使虐待正常化
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对家庭暴力中文化特定模式和亲属动态的理解，超越了传统的配偶关系框架
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要文化敏感的应对措施，考虑超越配偶关系的亲属动态，为针对南亚社区的家庭暴力干预提供实践指导

title: Automation-Induced Innovation Shift
affiliations: Cornell University - Samuel Curtis Johnson Graduate School of Management, University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business,  and Tsinghua University - School of Economics & Management

detail.title: Automation-Induced Innovation Shift
detail.abstract:
We study how exposure to automation affects the nature and level of corporate innovation, which informs how innovation begets innovation. We document that firms with high robot exposure alter their technological focus over time and shift innovative activities towards AI which automation naturally complements through data accumulation. The shift is more pronounced for firms with greater data generation or prior AI-related research experience. Because AI patents are more costly (e.g., in labor input), albeit more general and original, firms with high automation experience a significant rise in R&D expenditure but an initial drop in patent quantity, before benefiting—an innovation “J-Curve.” Our findings not only resolve the puzzle that globally firms invent less despite the greater research effort amidst rising automation, but also provides insights on the heterogeneous paths of innovation, all of which we rationalize in a parsimonious dynamic equilibrium model.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究发现企业在接触自动化后会向AI创新转移，导致R&D支出增加但创新数量初期下降（J-Curve效应），最终实现创新质量提升
AI.research_question: 自动化暴露如何影响企业创新的性质和水平
AI.motivation: 解决全球范围内企业研究投入增加但创新产出减少的谜因
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态均衡模型，创新引发创新的理论
AI.method: 实证分析高机器人暴露企业的创新模式变化
AI.findings: 高自动化企业向AI技术转移，AI专利更贵但更通用和原创，出现R&D支出增加、专利数量初期下降的J-Curve效应
AI.theory_contributions: 提出创新J-Curve理论，解释了自动化时代创新投入与产出矛盾现象
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在自动化转型期的创新策略提供指导，帮助政策制定者理解创新路径异质性

title: Revealing Domestic Abuse Realities and Viable Helpseeking Pathways for South Asian Women in Scotland Research Briefing 3 Marriage Patterns and Migration Realities
affiliations: University of Glasgow, University of Glasgow and University of Glasgow

detail.title: Revealing Domestic Abuse Realities and Viable Helpseeking Pathways for South Asian Women in Scotland Research Briefing 3 Marriage Patterns and Migration Realities
detail.abstract: Despite evidence of severe, culturally specific patterns of abuse and persistent barriers to support, little research has focused on the experiences of South Asian women in Scotland or how they understand and seek help for domestic abuse. Diversifying Justice addressed this gap through arts-based focus groups (n=15) and narrative interviews (n=14), conducted in Urdu and English, using a feminist, participatory methodology designed to prioritise care, reciprocity, and safe sharing of experiences. This briefing focuses on marriage patterns and migration realities. Participants described blurred boundaries between arranged and forced marriages, often shaped by emotional pressure and coercion. Cousin marriages and double rishta arrangements created complex kinship ties that increased pressure to remain in unsafe relationships. Migration, language barriers, and immigration status further deepened dependence and isolation, leaving women vulnerable to misinformation and control. Findings stress the need for culturally informed and linguistically accessible services.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过艺术焦点小组和叙事访谈探讨苏格兰南亚女性对家庭暴力的理解与求助经历，重点分析婚姻模式和移民现实如何加深她们的依赖与孤立。
AI.research_question: 苏格兰南亚女性如何理解和寻求家庭暴力帮助？婚姻模式和移民现实如何影响她们的求助经历？
AI.motivation: 尽管存在严重的文化特定虐待模式和持续的支持障碍，但针对苏格兰南亚女性家庭暴力经历的研究很少
AI.theoretical_framework: 女性主义参与式方法论，强调关怀、互惠和安全分享体验
AI.method: 艺术基础焦点小组（15人）和叙事访谈（14人），使用乌尔都语和英语进行
AI.findings: 包办婚姻与强迫婚姻界限模糊；堂亲婚姻和双重rishta安排造成复杂亲属关系；移民、语言障碍和移民身份加深依赖与孤立
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对文化特定家庭暴力模式的理解，特别是婚姻安排和移民因素的交织影响
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要文化知情和语言无障碍的服务支持

title: Measuring Neighborhood Change: The Issue of Ex Post Borders
affiliations: Harvard University - Department of Economics, University of Pennsylvania and Yale University

detail.title: Measuring Neighborhood Change: The Issue of Ex Post Borders
detail.abstract:
Do more populous neighborhoods grow less quickly than less populous areas? Is local housing price growth associated with initial population density? The Longitudinal Tract Data Base’s (LTDB) panel of Census tracts is the standard tool for measuring neighborhood change. The LTDB is based on 2010 Census tract boundaries, and Census tracts are partially designed so that they have a similar level of population. In this paper, we show that defining neighborhoods to equalize ex post population levels can significantly impact estimated coefficients in regressions in which population changes are regressed on initial population levels or with variables that are correlated with initial population levels. Most obviously, if neighborhood populations are ex post equalized, then a regression of population change on initial population must yield a coefficient of -1. We address this challenge by offering five alternative panels of tracts using 1970, 1980 and 1990 boundaries, which can be thought of as ‘reverse LTDBs’. The significant mean reversion of both population and housing units that appear in the LTDB before 2000 either dramatically ameliorates or reverses using the reverse LTDB. Comparing the LTDB with the reverse LTDB also finds that using tracts based on ex post borders also can influence estimated growth relationships where other tract-level attributes such as house price are correlated with initial population levels. This does not imply that using ex ante borders always is superior; earlier borders almost always means fewer observations, especially in rapidly growing areas.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，使用事后人口均等化的普查区边界定义邻里会显著影响回归系数估计，特别是人口变化对初始人口水平的回归。通过构建基于1970、1980和1990年边界的"反向LTDB"面板数据，发现LTDB中观察到的人口和住房单元均值回归现象在使用反向LTDB后明显减弱或逆转。
AI.research_question: 人口较多的邻里是否比人口较少的地区增长更慢？当地房价增长是否与初始人口密度相关？
AI.motivation: 纵向普查区数据库(LTDB)是基于2010年普查区边界的标准工具，但普查区的设计部分是为了使人口水平相似，这种事后人口均等化的邻里定义可能显著影响回归系数估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间计量经济学和面板数据分析理论，探讨邻里边界定义对人口和房价增长关系估计的影响。
AI.method: 构建五个基于1970、1980和1990年边界的替代普查区面板（"反向LTDB"），与标准LTDB进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 使用事后边界定义的普查区会导致人口变化对初始人口水平的回归系数必须为-1；LTDB中观察到的人口和住房单元均值回归现象在使用反向LTDB后明显减弱或逆转；当其他区级属性（如房价）与初始人口水平相关时，使用事后边界也会影响估计的增长关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了邻里边界定义方法对实证研究结果的重要影响，提出了使用事前边界的重要性，但同时也指出事前边界可能导致观测值减少的权衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了基于历史边界的替代面板数据工具（反向LTDB），为研究邻里变化提供了更准确的计量方法，对城市发展和住房政策研究具有重要实践价值。

title: The Foreign Currency Fisher Channel: Evidence from Households
affiliations: Utrecht University, European Central Bank (ECB) and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: The Foreign Currency Fisher Channel: Evidence from Households
detail.abstract:
We study how foreign currency debt exposure shapes household adjustment to a large exchange rate depreciation. Using household survey and bank customer data during Hungary's 2008 currency crisis, we find that foreign currency borrowers cut consumption one-for-one with increased debt service, consistent with a foreign currency Fisher channel. Both the quantity and quality of expenditures decline, indicating a "flight from quality." Debt revaluation has a limited effect on overall labor supply, but there is substitution toward foreign income and home production. Our findings point to the relevance of open-economy models with incomplete markets, heterogeneous foreign currency exposures, and liquidity constraints.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了匈牙利2008年货币危机期间，家庭外币债务敞口如何影响其应对汇率大幅贬值的调整行为。研究发现外币借款家庭消费与债务偿还增加呈一比一减少，存在"质量逃离"现象，劳动力供给总体影响有限但存在替代效应。
AI.research_question: 外币债务敞口如何影响家庭对大规模汇率贬值的调整？
AI.motivation: 研究外币债务在汇率危机中对家庭经济行为的影响，填补开放经济模型中不完全市场、异质性外币敞口和流动性约束的研究空白
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放经济模型、不完全市场理论、异质性外币敞口理论、流动性约束理论、外币费雪通道理论
AI.method: 使用匈牙利家庭调查数据和银行客户数据，分析2008年货币危机期间的家庭行为
AI.findings: 1) 外币借款人消费与债务偿还增加一比一减少；2) 支出数量和质量均下降，出现"质量逃离"；3) 债务重估对总体劳动力供给影响有限；4) 存在向国外收入和家庭生产的替代
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了开放经济模型中不完全市场、异质性外币敞口和流动性约束的相关性，发展了外币费雪通道理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了汇率危机中家庭债务管理的实证依据，有助于设计更好的金融稳定政策

title: Efficiency Costs of Incomplete Markets
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Efficiency Costs of Incomplete Markets
detail.abstract:
This paper quantifies misallocation caused by limited risk-sharing and imperfect consumption-smoothing. We measure these losses in terms of how much of society's resources would be left over if financial markets were complete and each consumer were compensated to maintain their status-quo welfare. Using exact formulas and approximate sufficient statistics, we analyze standard incomplete-market environments—ranging from closed-economy Bewley-Aiyagari models to multi-country settings with input-output linkages. We find that incomplete insurance against household-level idiosyncratic risk is very costly (about 20% of aggregate consumption) based on both structural models and sufficient-statistics computed using household consumption panel data. By contrast, the cost of imperfect international financial markets (abstracting from within-country heterogeneity) is roughly 5%, driven by the inclusion of fast-growing economies such as China and India. Unexploited risk-sharing opportunities among countries at similar levels of development, on the other hand, are fairly limited (less than 1%).

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了有限风险分担和不完全消费平滑导致的资源配置扭曲损失，发现家庭层面异质性风险的不完全保险成本很高（约20%总消费），而国际金融市场不完全的成本约为5%，发达国家间风险分担机会有限（<1%）。
AI.research_question: 不完全金融市场（包括家庭层面异质性风险和国际风险分担）导致的资源配置扭曲损失有多大？
AI.motivation: 量化金融市场不完全性对资源配置效率的影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: Bewley-Aiyagari不完全市场模型，多国设置下的投入产出联系框架。
AI.method: 使用精确公式和近似充分统计量，分析标准不完全市场环境，包括结构模型和基于家庭消费面板数据的充分统计计算。
AI.findings: 1. 家庭层面异质性风险的不完全保险成本约为20%总消费；2. 国际金融市场不完全成本约为5%（主要受中国、印度等快速增长经济体影响）；3. 相似发展水平国家间未开发的风险分担机会有限（<1%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了量化金融市场不完全性成本的理论框架和方法论，扩展了不完全市场理论的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了金融市场改革优先级的实证依据，指出应优先改善家庭层面的风险分担机制。

title: Tariffs, Manufacturing Employment, and Supply Chains
affiliations: University of Toronto

detail.title: Tariffs, Manufacturing Employment, and Supply Chains
detail.abstract:
I use a dynamic general-equilibrium model with supply-chain adjustment frictions to study the effects of tariffs on manufacturing employment. The model has four distinct manufacturing sectors: upstream goods with high trade elasticities (“oil”); upstream goods with low trade elasticities (“steel”); downstream goods with high trade elasticities (“toys”); and downstream goods with low trade elasticities (“cars”). I find that tariffs can increase overall manufacturing employment in the long run, but are likely to reduce it in the short run, and cause more reallocation of workers across these individual sectors than overall employment growth

title: Do Markets Believe in Transformative AI?
affiliations: Harvard Society of Fellows and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Do Markets Believe in Transformative AI?
detail.abstract:
Economic theory predicts that transformative technologies may influence interest rates by changing growth expectations, increasing uncertainty about growth, or raising concerns about existential risk. Examining US bond yields around major AI model releases in 2023-4, we find economically large and statistically significant movements concentrated at longer maturities. The median and mean yield responses across releases in our sample are negative: long-term Treasury, TIPS, and corporate yields fall and remain lower for weeks. Viewed through the lens of a simple, representative agent consumption-based asset pricing model, these declines correspond to downward revisions in expected consumption growth and/or a reduction in the perceived probability of extreme outcomes such as existential risk or arrival of a post-scarcity economy. By contrast, changes in consumption growth uncertainty do not appear to drive our results

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现2023-2024年主要AI模型发布时，美国长期债券收益率显著下降，表明市场对AI技术持谨慎态度，下调了长期经济增长预期和/或降低了极端风险（如存在性风险）的概率。
AI.research_question: AI技术发布如何影响利率和债券收益率？市场对AI技术的反应反映了怎样的经济增长预期变化？
AI.motivation: 经济理论预测颠覆性技术可能通过改变增长预期、增加增长不确定性或提高存在性风险担忧来影响利率，但缺乏实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代表性代理人消费资产定价模型，分析技术冲击对消费增长预期、不确定性和极端风险概率的影响。
AI.method: 使用事件研究方法，分析2023-2024年主要AI模型发布期间美国国债、TIPS和公司债券收益率的变化。
AI.findings: AI发布导致长期收益率显著下降且持续数周，中位数和平均收益率反应为负值，表明市场下调了长期增长预期和/或降低了极端风险概率。
AI.theory_contributions: 为技术冲击对金融市场的影响提供了实证证据，验证了消费资产定价模型在分析颠覆性技术影响时的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理解AI技术对利率和债券市场的影响提供参考，帮助政策制定者评估技术发展对金融稳定的影响。

title: The Theory of Financial Stability Meets Reality: A Unifying Framework for Bank Regulation and Accounting Discretion
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: The Theory of Financial Stability Meets Reality: A Unifying Framework for Bank Regulation and Accounting Discretion
detail.abstract:
A large literature at the intersection of economics and finance offers prescriptions for regulating banks to increase financial stability. This literature abstracts from the discretion that accounting standards give banks over financial reporting, creating a gap between the information assumed to be available to regulators in models of optimal regulation and the information available to regulators in reality. We bridge insights from the economics, finance, and accounting literatures to synthesize knowledge about the design and implementation of bank regulation and identify areas where more work is needed. We present a simple framework for organizing the relevant ideas, namely the externalities that motivate bank regulation, the rationales for allowing accounting discretion, and the use of discretion to circumvent regulation. Our takeaway from reviewing work in these areas is that academic studies of bank regulation and accounting discretion require a more unified approach to design optimal policy for the real world.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Utilitarian or Quantile-Welfare Evaluation of Health Policy?
affiliations: Northwestern University - Department of Economics and University of Wisconsin-Madison - Department of Population Health Sciences

detail.title: Utilitarian or Quantile-Welfare Evaluation of Health Policy?
detail.abstract:
This paper considers quantile-welfare evaluation of health policy as an alternative to utilitarian evaluation. Manski (1988) originally proposed and studied maximization of quantile utility as a model of individual decision making under uncertainty, juxtaposing it with maximization of expected utility. That paper's primary motivation was to exploit the fact that maximization of quantile utility requires only an ordinal formalization of utility, not a cardinal one. This paper transfers these ideas from analysis of individual decision making to analysis of social planning. We begin by summarizing basic theoretical properties of quantile welfare in general terms rather than related specifically to health policy. We then propose a procedure to nonparametrically bound the quantile welfare of health states using data from binary-choice time-tradeoff (TTO) experiments of the type regularly performed by health economists. After this we assess related econometric considerations concerning measurement, using the EQ-5D framework to structure our discussion.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用分位数福利评估作为健康政策评估的替代方法，替代传统的功利主义评估。该方法基于Manski(1988)的分位数效用最大化理论，只需要序数效用而非基数效用。论文将这一思想从个人决策分析扩展到社会规划分析，并提出了使用二元选择时间权衡实验数据非参数估计健康状态分位数福利边界的方法。

title: Crowning the Queen or King of Citation! Identifying the Most-Cited Authors and Publications in Marketing
affiliations: Southern Methodist University (SMU) - Marketing Department

detail.title: Crowning the Queen or King of Citation! Identifying the Most-Cited Authors and Publications in Marketing

publicationDetails.detailsText: SMU Cox School of Business Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: SMU Cox School of Business Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Citations have long been recognized as an indicator of an academic work's impact. The logic behind equating citation count to impact is that if the authors find value in the publication's content, they will use it to advance their research and cite it—i.e., refer to the publication in their works. In the academic field, an author’s reputation, faculty tenure and promotion, and journal quality have all based their impact measure on citation counts. Even a department's reputation depends on the collective citation counts of its faculty members. One reputed marketing department even advertises itself as the "most cited faculty in the world." Given its significance, on behalf of the Sethuraman family, it is my pleasure and honor to institute an annual citation award that identifies the most-cited authors and publications each year, starting from 2024.

This award is launched (in 2024) in fond memory of my father late Shri. G. Sethuraman. Born in 1924 in a family of 10+ children, my father’s parents could not afford a college education, and so he joined the military, fought in World War II, and entered the government workforce as a veteran. He had five children and always wondered when I would grow up! Unfortunately, he did not live long enough to see me graduate with a doctorate and passed away in 1986. This award is instituted in 2024 to commemorate his100th birthyear.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Sethuraman家族设立的年度引用奖项，旨在表彰每年被引用次数最多的作者和出版物，以此纪念作者父亲的100周年诞辰。
AI.research_question: 如何通过设立引用奖项来纪念作者父亲并促进学术影响力的认可？
AI.motivation: 引用次数长期以来被作为学术影响力的重要指标，影响着学者声誉、教职晋升和期刊质量。作者希望通过设立年度引用奖项来纪念父亲的100周年诞辰，同时促进学术界的认可机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于文献计量学理论，引用次数作为学术影响力的代理指标，反映了研究成果对学术界的贡献和影响程度。
AI.method: 通过设立年度奖项机制，每年评选被引用次数最多的作者和出版物，建立系统的评选和表彰流程。
AI.findings: 引用奖项的设立既是对已故父亲的纪念，也是对学术影响力认可机制的重要补充，预计将从2024年开始实施。
AI.theory_contributions: 为学术影响力评估提供了新的制度化认可形式，丰富了文献计量学在实践中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 建立了年度引用奖项体系，为学者提供了额外的荣誉激励，促进了学术影响力的公开认可和表彰。

title: Segregation, Spillovers, and the Locus of Racial Change
affiliations: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), Cornerstone Research and Columbia University

detail.title: Segregation, Spillovers, and the Locus of Racial Change
detail.abstract:
We use a discrete choice framework to provide the first nesting of Thomas C. Schelling’s canonical models of racial segregation amenable to empirical examination. Using U.S. Census data from 1970–2000, we demonstrate a central role for spatial racial spillovers in shaping racial clustering, patterns of racial shares and housing prices at the boundary of racial clusters, and the locus of racial change. Our results on the locus of racial change conflict strongly with prominent prior results on racial tipping. Our theory provides a foundation for spatially stratified regressions. The strongest spatial effects in the prior work are not tipping, but the distinct biased White suburbanization. Tipping effects in urban areas remote from Minority clusters are small or insignificant. In urban areas proximate to Minority clusters they average less than half those reported in prior pooled results. Policies promoting racial integration must thus attend to the heterogeneous fragility of neighborhoods.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用离散选择框架将Schelling的种族隔离模型首次嵌套到可实证检验的形式，基于1970-2000年美国人口普查数据，发现空间种族溢出效应在种族聚类、种族比例模式、住房价格边界和种族变化轨迹中起关键作用，结果与先前关于种族临界点的研究存在强烈冲突。
AI.research_question: 空间种族溢出效应如何影响种族聚类模式、种族比例变化轨迹以及住房价格边界？
AI.motivation: 将Schelling的经典种族隔离模型转化为可实证检验的形式，并验证空间种族溢出效应在种族动态变化中的核心作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Thomas C. Schelling的种族隔离模型，采用离散选择框架进行理论嵌套和扩展。
AI.method: 使用1970-2000年美国人口普查数据，采用空间分层回归分析方法。
AI.findings: 1) 先前研究中最强的空间效应不是种族临界点，而是白人郊区化偏见；2) 远离少数族裔集群的城市区域临界点效应很小或不显著；3) 靠近少数族裔集群的城市区域临界点效应平均不到先前汇总结果的一半。
AI.theory_contributions: 为Schelling的种族隔离模型提供了首个可实证检验的理论嵌套框架，为空间分层回归分析奠定了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示：促进种族融合的政策必须关注社区异质性的脆弱性，不能简单依赖临界点理论。

title: Deep Learning for Solving Economic Models
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - Department of Economics

detail.title: Deep Learning for Solving Economic Models
detail.abstract:
The ongoing revolution in artificial intelligence, especially deep learning, is transforming research across many fields, including economics. Its impact is particularly strong in solving equilibrium economic models. These models often lack closed-form solutions, so economists have relied on numerical methods such as value function iteration, perturbation, and projection techniques. While powerful, these approaches face the curse of dimensionality, making global solutions computationally infeasible as the number of state variables increases. Recent advances in deep learning offer a new paradigm: flexible tools that efficiently approximate complex functions, manage high-dimensional problems, and expand the reach of quantitative economics. After introducing the basic concepts of deep learning, I illustrate the approach with the neoclassical growth model and discuss related ideas, including the double descent phenomenon and implicit regularization.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 深度学习革命为经济学模型求解提供了新范式，通过神经网络有效解决高维状态变量下的均衡经济模型计算难题，突破了传统数值方法的维度诅咒限制。

AI.method: 采用深度学习技术，利用神经网络的函数近似能力来处理高维状态空间问题，并通过新古典增长模型进行实证演示。
AI.findings: 深度学习能够有效解决传统数值方法无法处理的高维均衡经济模型，提供了计算可行的全局解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 将深度学习范式引入经济学模型求解，拓展了定量经济学的理论边界，为解决高维经济问题提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学家提供了实用的计算工具，使处理复杂高维经济模型成为可能，推动了定量经济学研究的实际应用范围。

title: Emerging Trends in Sales Agency Relationships : Legal, Strategic, and Technological Perspectives
affiliations: Professional Website

detail.title: Emerging Trends in Sales Agency Relationships : Legal, Strategic, and Technological Perspectives

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract:
Sales agency relationships, once largely transactional, are undergoing a profound transformation. Traditionally, manufacturers relied on independent representatives to extend market reach, especially in foreign territories where building an in-house sales force was impractical. These arrangements were simple in structure, focusing on territory, commissions, and exclusivity. Today, however, the forces of digital transformation, shifting customer expectations, and regulatory complexity have disrupted this model.

Manufacturers increasingly view sales agents as strategic partners rather than mere intermediaries. Agents are expected to master customer data, deploy advanced digital tools, and align with broader corporate goals such as sustainability and compliance. In response, sales agency agreements have grown more sophisticated, incorporating provisions on AI usage, data rights, ESG standards, and performance metrics that move beyond sales volume. At the same time, manufacturers must navigate diverse foreign legal regimes, privacy regulations, and the risk of misclassification. 

This article examines the evolution of sales agency relationships through historical context, emerging business dynamics, legal and compliance challenges, and innovative collaboration models. It argues that the future of these relationships lies in deep integration, shared value creation, and forward-looking governance. Those who adapt will not only achieve stronger commercial results but also build resilience for the decades ahead.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了销售代理关系从传统交易模式向战略合作伙伴关系的深刻转型，分析了数字化、客户期望变化和监管复杂性如何重塑这一关系，并提出了深度整合、共同价值创造和前瞻性治理的未来发展方向。
AI.research_question: 销售代理关系如何从传统的交易模式演变为现代的战略合作伙伴关系？这种转型面临哪些业务动态、法律合规挑战和创新合作模式？

title: An Exploratory Study of the Impact of Consumerism on Behavioural Intentions in the Tertiary and Higher Education Market in the Gambia
affiliations: The Gambia University of Applied Science

detail.title: An Exploratory Study of the Impact of Consumerism on Behavioural Intentions in the Tertiary and Higher Education Market in the Gambia
detail.abstract: Purpose: This study sought to investigate the link between consumerism and the behavioural intentions of tertiary and higher education students in The Gambia. Specifically, the study sought to address the following research question: To what extent does consumerism influence the behavioural intentions of tertiary and higher education students in The Gambia? Design/Method/Approach: The research design was underpinned by an intra-paradigm qualitative mixed-methods approach to data collection. This approach supported a preliminary analysis of the contents of 24 carefully selected document sources. Documentary analysis was followed by telephonic and face-to-face in-depth interviews with 59 participants who were recruited from three universities. The study used the flow theory as a supporting framework of analysis. Findings: The findings indicate a pattern of goal-oriented behaviour that is consistent with consumerist intentions. This conclusion is based on evidence showing an increasing demand for value-oriented exchange, particularly in terms of programme quality, graduate employment outcomes, teaching and learning support structures, and overall student engagement strategies at universities. Theoretical Implications: The study bridges the existing knowledge gap on the validity of the notion of consumerism in Gambian universities. Practical Implications: The findings provide a framework for higher education managers to align with the trend of value-oriented behaviour among students in the design and implementation of institutional value propositions. Originality/Value: This study validates the existence of consumerist behaviour in Gambian universities and paves the way for the use of evidence in the design and proposition of value in the tertiary and higher education sector. Research Limitations/Future Research: The transdisciplinary interpretations of consumerism in tertiary and higher education emerged as an area of future research in this study.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了冈比亚高等教育学生的消费主义与行为意图之间的关系，发现学生表现出以价值为导向的消费主义行为模式，对教育质量、就业结果和学校支持服务有明确需求。
AI.research_question: 消费主义在多大程度上影响冈比亚高等教育学生的行为意图？
AI.motivation: 填补冈比亚大学消费主义概念有效性方面的知识空白，了解学生消费主义行为对高等教育的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动理论（Flow Theory）作为支持性分析框架
AI.method: 采用定性混合方法研究设计，包括24份文献资料的初步内容分析，以及对来自三所大学的59名参与者进行的电话和面对面深度访谈
AI.findings: 研究发现学生表现出与消费主义意图一致的目标导向行为模式，显示出对价值导向交换的日益增长需求，特别是在课程质量、毕业生就业结果、教学支持结构和整体学生参与策略方面
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了消费主义概念在冈比亚大学的有效性，为理解高等教育中的消费主义行为提供了理论支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育管理者提供了框架，帮助他们在设计和实施机构价值主张时与学生价值导向行为趋势保持一致

title: Substituting Talent with Transactions: Acquisitions as Responses to Immigration Restrictions
affiliations: Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - RSM Erasmus University, Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania and University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School

detail.title: Substituting Talent with Transactions: Acquisitions as Responses to Immigration Restrictions
detail.abstract:
We examine how firms respond to talent scarcity caused by restrictive immigration policies. We argue that when firms cannot build capabilities internally through hiring, they alter their boundaries by engaging in corporate acquisitions to make up for the foregone talent and capabilities. Using data on 3,861 U.S. firms and their use of the H-1B visa program (2001-2020), we leverage two exogenous shocks—the 2004 H-1B cap reduction and the 2007-2008 visa lottery—and find causal evidence that firms make more acquisitions as their exposure to immigration restrictions rises. This effect is stronger for deals with purposes related to the skills of the foregone talent, for small acquisitions, for domestic targets, and for targets in places with higher concentrations of skilled workers.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，当企业因移民限制政策无法通过招聘获得所需人才时，会转而通过企业并购来弥补人才和能力的缺失。基于2001-2020年美国H-1B签证数据，利用2004年签证配额削减和2007-2008年签证抽签两个外生冲击，提供了企业因移民限制而增加并购活动的因果证据。
AI.research_question: 限制性移民政策导致人才稀缺时，企业如何应对？企业是否会通过并购来弥补因移民限制而无法获得的人才和能力？
AI.motivation: 人才是企业竞争力的关键，但限制性移民政策可能阻碍企业获取所需人才。理解企业在这种约束下的战略调整具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业边界理论，当内部能力建设受阻时，企业会通过并购等外部方式获取所需资源和能力。
AI.method: 使用2001-2020年美国3,861家企业的H-1B签证数据，利用2004年H-1B配额削减和2007-2008年签证抽签两个外生政策冲击作为自然实验，采用因果推断方法。
AI.findings: 企业面临移民限制时显著增加并购活动；这种效应在与缺失技能相关的交易、小型收购、国内目标以及高技能人才集中地区的目标中更为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了企业边界理论，揭示了人才获取约束如何影响企业并购决策，为理解企业在制度约束下的战略调整提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者在人才稀缺环境下的战略选择提供指导，为政策制定者评估移民政策对企业行为的影响提供实证依据。

title: Inward and Outward Migration under Shifting Legal-Democratic Regimes
affiliations: Tel Aviv University - Eitan Berglas School of Economics

detail.title: Inward and Outward Migration under Shifting Legal-Democratic Regimes
detail.abstract:
This paper analyzes the two-way relationship between international migration and political regime change, highlighting a feedback loop in which political shifts shape migration flows, while migration itself reshapes political trajectories. Relying on a Difference-in-Differences (DiD) framework and a dataset combining migration flows, regime quality indicators (CHRI), and measures of international integration, we identify three central results.First, substantial immigration into politically fragile democracies undermines institutional quality. The 2015 Syrian shock provides a particularly valuable exogenous case: a sudden, large-scale refugee inflow that bypassed domestic policy controls and provoked sharp political responses, allowing for clearer identification of immigration’s institutional effects. Second, democratic decline increases emigration, draining human capital and further weakening prospects for democratic recovery. Third, international integration—most notably through EU accession—conditions these dynamics, amplifying or dampening the outflow response to political change.Taken together, these findings show that migration is not merely a symptom of political instability but also a driver of institutional transformation, simultaneously reinforcing and accelerating regime shifts toward illiberalism.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了国际移民与政治体制变革之间的双向关系，发现移民既是政治不稳定的结果，也是制度转型的驱动力，形成了一种相互强化的反馈循环。
AI.research_question: 国际移民与政治体制变革之间是否存在双向因果关系？移民如何影响制度质量，同时政治体制变化又如何影响移民流动？
AI.motivation: 理解移民与政治体制之间的复杂互动关系，揭示移民不仅是政治不稳定的结果，也是制度转型的重要驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政治经济学和移民研究理论框架，探讨移民流动与政治体制质量之间的双向因果关系和反馈机制。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（DiD）分析框架，结合移民流动数据、政权质量指标（CHRI）和国际一体化程度测量数据。
AI.findings: 1）大规模移民涌入会削弱脆弱民主国家的制度质量；2）民主衰退会增加移民流出，导致人力资本流失；3）国际一体化（如欧盟加入）调节这些动态关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了移民与政治体制变革的双向反馈理论，突破了传统单向因果关系的理解框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于移民管理和政治稳定的重要启示，特别是在处理难民危机和民主转型过程中的政策设计。
